svg.title: compose-new-comment · expanded · 160x48
svg.text: Agreed, and I think the README should say so explicitly. Here's what I'd add under Keys:
move one line and stop at either end of the file; they never wrap around.
jumps to the last line and
move by hunk, and stop at the first and the last hunk.
I also checked the three cases you listed against the current build. All three behave as described, so I don't think we need a code change here, just the
docs. If you want, I can open a follow-up for the wrap-around idea, since a few people asked for it in the discussion, but I'd keep it behind a setting so
the default stays the same as today.
One more thing: the help panel lists
as "Line down" but the footer says "Down". We should pick one. I'd go with the help panel's wording because it's
more specific, and the footer has room for it at 100 columns.
Open a file longer than the screen
on a file with three hunks
Every one of them stopped where the docs will say it stops. The only surprise was
on the first hunk, which does nothing rather than wrapping to the last
one, and that matches the rest.
Finally, the screenshot in the README is from 0.5 and still shows the old title bar. I'll refresh it in the same PR, and add one of the diff view with a
cursor on a hunk header, since that's the part people ask about.
A few notes for whoever picks up the wrap-around follow-up:
keep the default as it is today
put the setting next to the other viewer settings
respect it too, so the keys stay consistent
add a snapshot for the wrapped position at both widths
I'll link this thread from the follow-up so the context isn't lost. If anything in the list above looks wrong, say so here and I'll fix it before the PR
Thanks again for the careful report. The steps made this quick to check.
